journeys.title: Northstar Evidence Brief
journeys.prompt: Use the local source file local-source.md and the web source at {{WEB_SOURCE_URL}}. Create northstar-evidence-brief.docx and northstar-evidence-brief.pdf in this workspace. Title both Northstar Evidence Brief. Cite LOCAL-001 and WEB-001 next to the claims they support, include a Sources section, and include an honest Limitations section. Validate the native DOCX and PDF before reporting completion. Do not call an output verified unless Wayland shows a trusted Core receipt for its exact digest.
journeys.revisionPrompt: Make one scoped revision to both outputs: change only the title to Northstar Evidence Brief - Revised. Preserve both facts, both source IDs, the Sources section, and the Limitations section. Revalidate both native files and require fresh trusted Core receipts for their new exact digests.
